caseNameFull: Edward C. Mason, as he is Trustee in Bankruptcy, etc. v. Thomas J. Shannon
summary: Error to the Superior Court of the State of Massachusetts.
attorneys: Mr. Harold Williams, Jr., with whom Mr. Charles E. Fay was on the briefs, for plaintiff in error.., Mr. John T. Hughes, with whom Mr. James H. Vahey and Mr. Philip Mansfield were on the brief, for defendants in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of' § 237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, § 2, 39 Stat. 726.
